title: Recovery vs Strain Imbalance Warning
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), WHOOP recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body and blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, WHOOP, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whoop:cycle
| eval strain_recovery_gap=strain_score-(recovery_score/5)
| where strain_score>=16 AND recovery_score<50
| sort - strain_recovery_gap
description: Pairs WHOOP strain and recovery scores to highlight days where you are pushing hard while your body is plainly asking for less.
value: Numbers that say 'low recovery, high strain' are the wearable equivalent of a dashboard light; catching that mismatch early prevents stubborn overtraining loops.
implementation: Ingest WHOOP cycle summaries; schedule every morning and trim the day's intensity when poor recovery and high strain collide.
visualization: Scatter plot of strain versus recovery with the danger quadrant highlighted.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when your body looks under-recovered but you are still piling on a hard day of effort.
